=[
  { "name": "invoice_number", "type": "string", "required": true, "description": "The invoice or reference number" },
  { "name": "amount_due", "type": "number", "required": true, "description": "The total amount to be paid" },
  { "name": "currency", "type": "string", "description": "ISO currency code of the amount due" },
  { "name": "due_date", "type": "date", "required": true, "description": "The date the payment is due" },
  { "name": "iban", "type": "string", "description": "The IBAN the invoice should be paid to" }

nodes.name: Say why a human is needed

assignments.name: reasons

parameters.content:
## 1. The request arrives

A POST with the invoice email as JSON.

## 2. Your policy

Confidence floor, amount ceiling, expected currency.

## 3. The parse

Fields are defined on the canvas; doubtful ones leave by the second output.

## 4. The decision

A score built from checkable facts, never a coin flip.

## 5. Three honest answers

approved, review with the reasons, or 422.

## 6. When it cannot be read

A 422 with the reason in it, never a silent success.

## Screen and triage invoice emails with MailMint

An invoice email arrives as JSON. MailMint reads the fields you name out of the message and returns, per field, a confidence, the layer the value came from and the verbatim text it was read from.

This workflow turns that into a decision: pay it automatically, or hand it to a human — and it always says why.

## How the decision is made

**Policy** — everything you would otherwise hard-code sits in one Set node: the confidence you insist on, the amount a machine may approve alone, and the currency you expect. Sender authentication is off by default, because a message posted to a webhook has no envelope to check; switch it on when the mail arrives through a MailMint inbound address.

**Score** — the lowest per-field confidence, whether the evidence is really in the message, whether SPF/DKIM/DMARC passed, and whether the amount is inside your ceiling. Every answer carries its reasons.

## Try it

```
curl -X POST <this webhook URL> \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"subject":"Invoice INV-7781",
       "text":"Amount due: 1,284.00 EUR\nDue date: 2026-09-30"}'
```

**Setup:** add your MailMint API key as a MailMint credential on *Read the invoice fields*, then activate. A free key covers 300 messages a month, and no inbound address is needed for this shape.
